meta_title: Waimea Dental Studio | Digital, cosmetic and implant dentistry in Waimea, Hawaii
meta_desc: Digital dentistry, guided implant surgery and same-day crowns with Dr. Justin Chan in Waimea, Hawaii.

about_heading: A digital practice, built for Waimea
about_body:
Dr. Justin Chan opened Waimea Dental Studio in 2025 to give Kamuela a general and cosmetic practice that runs on digital workflows rather than around them.

In practice that means scanning instead of guessing, implants placed to a plan, and a crown designed and fitted while you are still in the chair. The same standard of care, in fewer appointments.

services.name: Same-day crowns
services.blurb: Designed and fitted in a single visit instead of spread across two appointments.

services.name: Guided implant surgery
services.blurb: Implants planned digitally, then placed to that plan for a predictable result.

services.name: Digital dentistry
services.blurb: Scanning and digital planning run through the practice, from first record to final fit.

services.blurb: Routine check-ups, restorative work and cosmetic treatment for adults and families.
